gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8543 covers electrical machines and apparatus having individual functions; the 8543.70.4 group names defrosters and demisters with electric resistors for aircraft; chapter 85 note 1 and section XVI notes do not exclude it
GRI 6: within the group, flight data recorders (8543.70.42) are not applicable, so the other line 8543.70.45 applies

rejected_alternatives.reason: flight data recorders, not a deicer
chemical deicing fluid (runway deicer), not an electrical device
electric heating for domestic/industrial use; the aircraft defroster/demister line in 8543.70 is more specific

missing_facts: whether the deicer uses electric resistance elements (assumed) and whether it is a part of a particular aircraft system
classification.rationale: The 8543.70 subheading group expressly provides for defrosters and demisters with electric resistors for aircraft; an electrical aircraft deicer is of that kind and falls in the 'Other' line 8543.70.45 of the group. No on-point ruling found.
